CustomField.formula: "KW " & TEXT( IF( CEILING((DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - 1) + 4), 1, 3) + WEEKDAY(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - 1) + 4), 1, 3)) - 5) / 7) = 0, CEILING((DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - 1) + 4) - 1, 1, 3) + WEEKDAY(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - 1) + 4) - 1, 1, 3)) - 5) / 7), CEILING((DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - 1) + 4), 1, 3) + WEEKDAY(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(Planned_Check_Date__c) - 1) + 4), 1, 3)) - 5) / 7) ) )
CustomField.label: Weeknumber (Planned Date)
